tools.name: car_reliability
tools.description: How reliable is a UK used car model, what are its common problems and its common MOT failures? First-time MOT fail rate against the average car of the same age, by year, and the faults it fails on most, from over 100 million DVSA MOT tests.

tools.name: compare_cars
tools.description: Which is more reliable, car A or car B? Compares two UK models' MOT fail rates for their age, side by side.

tools.name: most_reliable_cars
tools.description: The most and least reliable used cars in the UK by MOT test, overall or by segment (small car, family car, SUV, executive, MPV, estate).

tools.name: mileage_check
tools.description: Is this mileage high, low or typical for a used car of its age? From the model's median MOT mileage at each age; also how many miles a year the model usually does.

tools.name: car_safety_recalls
tools.description: Are there safety recalls on this car? DVSA safety recalls for a UK car model, each with the build dates it covers.

tools.name: ulez_check
tools.description: Is a car ULEZ compliant? Whether it meets London's ULEZ and UK clean air zone standards, from its fuel and when it was first registered.

tools.name: road_tax
tools.description: How much is the road tax (VED) on a UK car a year? From when it was first registered, its fuel and CO2.

tools.name: check_vehicle
tools.description: Free UK car check by number plate: MOT history, mileage record with rollback warnings, ULEZ, road tax, recalls and reliability. Needs a free GetFreeCarCheck API key (getfreecarcheck.co.uk/developers).

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search UK car models by name; returns ids to fetch.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch the full reliability report for a model id from search.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
